decisions.question: heartbeat_echo: new top-level WS type or overload irc_event?
decisions.decision: New top-level WS type `{type:'heartbeat_echo', cid, bid[], ts}`. Batched per network (one frame per 30s with bid[] array, NOT one frame per buffer).
decisions.rationale: Cleaner than overloading irc_event with discriminator; matches IRCCloud oob-include pattern; old clients silently ignore unknown types

decisions.question: prefVersion storage: Redis hash counter or inlined JSON field?
decisions.decision: Inlined JSON field (`UserPreferences.prefVersion: long`). Atomic increment+save via Redis MULTI/EXEC. prefVersion resolves engine-vs-client but NOT tab-vs-tab (already handled by localStorage events).
decisions.rationale: Inlined approach uses existing atomic redis.setJson() — one write, one read. INCR adds second key without win since mergePreferences loads whole blob anyway

decisions.question: buffersToDelete: always-on per reconnect or diff-mode?
decisions.decision: Always-on per WS reconnect (NOT per IRC reconnect). Client-side guard: `(bid NOT in activeJoinList)` before deletion. Intersect with archived/pinned/hidden maps.
decisions.rationale: Always-on is simpler and matches IRCCloud; client-side guard prevents deleting fresh user re-joins between engine snapshot and client receipt

decisions.question: temp_unavailable: countdown in MessageList or BufferHeader?
decisions.decision: Render in BufferHeader (per-buffer). Engine emits `idle:since` per NETWORK (one timer per connection). Client countdown anchored on `serverTs + remaining_ms` not `Date.now() + countdown_ms` to avoid clock drift.
decisions.rationale: Per-buffer state belongs in BufferHeader; MessageList is scrolling chat area. Per-NETWORK timer (not per-channel); per-NICK idle is separate (Member list dim)

decisions.question: Cmd+K: cross-network search or active-network only?
decisions.decision: Cross-network with disambiguation badge showing `serverName` (matches IRCCloud). Single bulk `/api/buffers/archive-names` endpoint (W3-T01a engine task — NOT per-network). Component takes `scope: 'all' | 'active'` prop for future refactor.
decisions.rationale: Matches IRCCloud channel-switch-dialog.es6:175-238 pattern; power-user friendly for 3+ network users; bulk endpoint avoids N parallel requests

pre_mortems.scenario: Wave 1 wire-format changes break existing pre-update clients
pre_mortems.mitigation: Gate all Wave 1 wire changes behind feature flags; default OFF for first wave deploy. See PM7 for two-phase deploy ordering.

pre_mortems.scenario: R#6 Ignore migration silently breaks existing ignore list (e.g. nick 'evil*' was regex wildcard, becomes literal)
pre_mortems.mitigation: Heuristic: upgrade ONLY pure bare-nick (no !, @, *, ?). Patterns with any separator OR wildcard preserved as-is in 3-level map (host='*', user='*', nick=literal). Console-log original before transformation.

pre_mortems.scenario: R#5 buffersToDelete deletes user-rejoined channels on reconnection
pre_mortems.mitigation: Client-side guard `(bid NOT in activeJoinList)`; intersect with archived/pinned/hidden maps.

pre_mortems.scenario: W1-T01 only fixes half the gap (handlePrefUpdate but not mergePreferences)
pre_mortems.mitigation: W1-T01 MUST add conversationsCollapsed to BOTH paths; acceptance criteria explicitly cover both.

pre_mortems.scenario: Wave 4 theme picker regresses default dark theme
pre_mortems.mitigation: All targets (Chrome 90+, Safari 14+, Firefox 90+) support CSS custom properties; verify via existing _midnight.scss precedence; browser-test against default dark before toggling.

pre_mortems.scenario: Wave 5 WS→XHR fallback sends duplicate events on WS reconnect mid-stream
pre_mortems.mitigation: maxEidTracker for eid-based dedup; explicit 'WS primary, XHR shadow' lifecycle. See PM8 for XHR lifecycle race.

pre_mortems.scenario: Wave 1 deploy order races with frontend refresh (engine-before-frontend)
pre_mortems.mitigation: Two-phase deploy for Wave 1: frontend FIRST via make update-assets, wait ≥10 minutes, THEN engine via make handoff.

pre_mortems.scenario: Wave 5 XHR fallback double-applies events on WS reconnect race
pre_mortems.mitigation: Explicit 'WS primary, XHR shadow' lifecycle: WS on → XHR off (close XHR); WS off → XHR on. xhrStreamHandler.close() on WS reconnection success BEFORE WS handshake completes.

pre_mortems.scenario: Wave 4 theme picker drops default dark theme on cache-bust for existing midnight users
pre_mortems.mitigation: W4b-T03 keeps `#app.midnight-theme` as backward-compat selector. W4a-T13 visual regression test with saved `theme: 'midnight'` localStorage value verifies.

pre_mortems.scenario: Wave 3 archive-names endpoint server RAM cost (500+ archives = ~50KB JSON per Cmd+K open)
pre_mortems.mitigation: 5-minute in-memory TTL on client cache; re-fetch on cache age > TTL. Server-side: bulk Mongo query + Redis cache invalidated on PART.

pre_mortems.scenario: Wave 5 lastSpoke persistence creates Mongo hot-write path
pre_mortems.mitigation: Debounce persist to 30s per (networkId, nick); skip if delta < 60s. Redis hash (NOT Mongo) with 30s debounce per key.
